name: Prove and fix a bug
description: Reproduce one reported defect, make the smallest safe fix, and prove the regression is guarded without hiding uncertainty.

outcomes.description: The original failure is captured as a deterministic before-state check.
The narrow fix passes its regression check and relevant neighboring tests.

prerequisites.description: The defect has a concrete input, observed result, and expected result.
prerequisites.check: Read the report and restate it without guessing at the cause.

prerequisites.description: The current behavior can be observed without changing production data or credentials.
prerequisites.check: Run the smallest safe reproduction and preserve its output.

lanes.objective: Write and run a failing reproduction that names the expected and actual state.
Apply the smallest implementation change that addresses the proven cause.
Run the regression and relevant neighboring checks, including the failure path.

qualityGates.description: The pre-fix check fails for the stated reason and does not rely on timing luck.
The focused regression passes without weakening the assertion or broadening scope.
Relevant neighboring tests and a clean diff show no unrelated regression.

ownerConfirmationBoundaries.action: Enter a password, one-time code, passkey, or challenge response.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.boundary: Stop and hand the entry to the owner; prepare context without typing or recording the secret.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.reason: Authentication material is a human-only boundary.

ownerConfirmationBoundaries.action: Apply a destructive data change, account-security change, or live financial action while fixing the defect.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.boundary: Stop before the action and obtain one explicit owner confirmation for that individual action.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.reason: A bug fix can be verified in a safe environment without live impact.

rollbackRescue.rollbackPlan: Keep the failing reproduction and return to the last known-good change if the fix does not explain the failure.
rescueSteps: Preserve the first failure and the exact changed scope.
Record a clear hypothesis and what evidence is missing.
Mark the lane abandoned if a repeatable proof cannot be recovered.
stopConditions: The fix requires unrelated behavior changes.
A protected owner boundary is reached.

redactionRules: Omit credentials, tokens, private paths, and personal data.
Include error names and safe summaries without payload secrets.
